text: 26 year old uncircumcised male here. I couldn’t retract my foreskin until about 17 and when I finally did there was a white/yellow buildup underneath. Washed it off and now I clean the area regularly with soap and water. Almost ten years later, if I go a few days without washing (like on a camping trip), the same yeast-like stuff returns. Is this likely a yeast infection or something else?

Started feeling really tired two days ago, then got a runny nose. Now the symptoms have moved to my chest—cough brings up mucus and I started to lose my voice last night, which is still hoarse today. Not sure if it’s a cold or the flu or if I should see someone about it. Thoughts?

Meri cousin Kalpana apni padhai ko lekar kaafi depressed ho gayi hai. Usko lagta hai ki woh kuch nahi kar payegi, woh khud ko barbad samajhti hai, kehti hai ki usne ghamand kiya tha isliye Bhagwan ne use saza di. Woh baar-baar rota hai. Aise situation mein mujhe kya karna chahiye taki woh normal ho sake?

I have asthma and recently started on steroids, antibiotics, breathing treatments, and cough syrup. Eight days ago I had a severe headache, which was diagnosed as my first migraine, and at that time I didn’t have cold symptoms. Six days ago I developed a cough, sore throat, and laryngitis, which have continued. Today I developed worsening shortness of breath, so I went to the doctor. My asthma symptoms have gotten worse over the past year, and I’ve lost my voice twice in the last three months with similar symptoms. Can you explain what early or pre-asthma symptoms are, and whether severe headache or voice loss could be signals I’m heading toward a major asthma flare? Also, when I cough my chin gets itchy—what might cause that?

My 3-year-old has a fever and is complaining of stomach pain, headache, eye pain, and leg pain. I used cold compresses and the fever lowered but now seems to be coming back. What could be causing this and what steps should I take?

List these symptoms for me: persistent back pain from neck to lower back (left side), extreme fatigue, abdominal fullness, nausea, stomach tightening, tender lower abdomen, and muscle weakness. What could this indicate?

I was diagnosed with typhoid fever three weeks ago and had chocolate-colored (thick blood, likely due to internal bleeding) stool. My doctor prescribed medicine, which I have been taking for three weeks, but I still don’t feel well—extreme weakness, sexual weakness, constant fatigue, and trouble doing daily tasks. Are these symptoms just lingering effects of typhoid, or could there be another issue?

My uncle is 86, slim, about 5'8", and has lung scarring. He had a stent placed about 7 years ago, which mostly worked except for occasional chest infections that cleared up with antibiotics. For the past 3 months he’s had ongoing cold-like symptoms that haven’t gone away. What could be causing this?

43-year-old active woman, not overweight. For the last few days I've had chest heaviness, chest/shoulder/neck pain, heart palpitations (skipping beats), weakness, and fatigue. My mother has angina, so I'm worried it could be the same. I have a doctor’s appointment in a week. Should I wait or go to the hospital?

I am 44 years old and currently weigh 106 kg. My father passed away last year during heart surgery for angina pectoris due to blocked heart arteries. I developed hypertension about 3 years ago when I was 130 kg and started taking Atacand 4 mg. My blood pressure was controlled at around 135/85 after that. About five months ago, I started having episodes of sudden dizziness and increased blood pressure, so my medication was switched to Concor 5 mg. These symptoms seem to come back when I am under stress and have long meetings.

I was diagnosed with RRMS 17 years ago. I experience exhaustion, headaches, and sometimes a burning sensation in my forearm. A couple of months ago, I had a fall and suffered a concussion. My MRI showed a white matter mass on my frontal horn. What effects could this have? My memory and balance have not been the same since.

I have posthumous sperm from my husband with 15% viability, and I haven’t seen a fertility doctor yet. The sperm bank told me the chance of conceiving is one in a million. Is this accurate, or do I still have a realistic chance of conceiving?

I've had a red mole on my left breast for years that bleeds often and has gotten bigger. Two months ago it bled again and now it looks like part of the mole is hanging out. I'm scheduled to have it removed next week after seeing a consultant dermatologist. Can you explain how the removal procedure works, if I should be worried about cancer, and what kind of pain or discomfort to expect after the removal?
I'm a 45-year-old woman named Katrina and I've had Melasma for 3 years. I've tried Melacare, Betnovate, and some homeopathy treatments without success. Can you suggest an effective cream for Melasma?

My sister has stage 4 cervical cancer, it's in all her lymph nodes with a tumor on her uterus and masses in her lungs. They are not offering treatment. Can you estimate how much time she might have left?

I was diagnosed with spondylolisthesis/spondylosis about 5 years ago, mainly due to playing sports. Since graduating from college softball, I’ve continued to have major lower back pain and a strong shooting pain down my right leg, affecting my lower back, right thigh side, and right side below my knee. I now stand most of the day at work. Is this ongoing pain still related to my original diagnosis, or could it be something different?

I've previously been treated for bronchitis. My breathing is normal during daily activities, but when I get excited, exercise, run, or am in cold weather, I struggle to breathe and have to stop until I recover. Is there a solution for this?

For the past three nights I’ve been getting random lumps under my skin that itch a lot. They’ve appeared on my arm, back, breast, and over my right eye. I haven’t changed any routines or tried anything new recently. What could be causing this?
I had a scan due to recurring diarrhea, stomach pain, gas, and acidity. The ultrasound report states: "Liver shows mild impairment of echotexture." What does this mean?

I’m an 18-year-old male and I’ve had jaundice for 3 weeks. I’ve seen two doctors: my family doctor and a jaundice specialist. One says I can eat everything (including non-veg, just less fried), the other says I shouldn’t. I’m confused about what to do. Can you help clarify?

I’m 57 and for the past 3 months I’ve had shortness of breath when active and wheezing at night when lying down. I’ve seen my doctor about 3 times but still feel lost. My chest feels like I put Vicks inside it or like I’m breathing in cold air. I mainly cough at night. What could be causing these symptoms? I’m getting really frustrated.

My 11-year-old cousin was bitten by our dog last December 2009. She received all recommended anti-rabies vaccines then (4 shots verurob, 1 shot anti-rabies serum, and anti-tetanus toxoid). The dog is up to date on anti-rabies shots and was vaccinated again on December 29, 2010. Tonight (July 10), my cousin was bitten again by the same dog, this time a small scratch on her lower lip. Does she need the full 4-shot verurob vaccine series again?
A friend of my family says they’re experiencing bugs coming out of their eyes and anus—tiny specs that aren’t visible to the naked eye. Can you suggest possible causes or cures for this?

My wisdom tooth broke in half but I don't want to get it removed right now. The inner part is exposed and in direct contact. Can you tell me how I can take care of it and if there’s any cream or medicine that can help it heal or seal the area?

Is it common for someone with hydrocephalus to also have a seizure disorder, possibly because of disrupted electrical activity in the brain? I’ve had hydrocephalus since I was three months old and I’m now 55. My seizures started when I was 17. I take several medications and have a vagus nerve stimulator. Let me know if you need more info.

I'm 31 and I've never had a checkup with an OB. I've been in a relationship for 6 years and we've had unprotected sex the whole time, but I still can't get pregnant. My period comes every month, but it's always about a week late. I'm scared I might be infertile—I really want to have a baby, that's my biggest dream. What should I do?

Whenever something sharp like my cat’s claw touches certain spots on my body, I feel the sensation in a completely different area (for example, right rib gets touched but I feel it in my right elbow). I’ve asked doctors about this for years but no one has an answer. I was diagnosed with Fibromyalgia in 1996 and I’m aware it’s related to nerve pain, but I also get sudden hot or wet feeling spots on my skin. Could this mean my diagnosis is wrong, or is there another condition that fits all these symptoms?

I’ve had two DVTS before and now have a bruise with a white lump on my elbow. The bruise appeared about a week ago, but I just noticed the lump in the last couple days. I don’t recall injuring my elbow. My last INR on 9/25/14 was 2.9. Should I be worried about this?

I’ve had an Implanon in my arm since November 2010. Recently, I’ve started experiencing a lot of numbness and tingling in my right arm and hand—the same arm the implant is in. Otherwise, I don’t have any side effects. Should I be worried about this?

I developed a red, pimply rash on my shoulders and upper back about five days ago after camping last weekend. I've tried cortisone and Benadryl, but the rash is still there, and now I've got prickly sensations all over my body—not just where the rash is. My skin is very sensitive and I have known allergies to soaps, detergents, and plants. Could this be from brushing up against something while camping? What could be going on and what should I do?

I'm a 36-year-old healthy woman with a small, sharp, persistent pain in my back, possibly under the clavicle, around the mid-thoracic area. It's been there for at least 5 months, never goes away, and gets worse as the day goes on or when I breathe in. Anti-inflammatories help, and there's no shortness of breath linked to the pain. Should I be concerned? If it's nothing serious, why hasn’t it resolved after all this time?

I just started Neoclav 625mg for swelling gum and lower molar pain, but after a dentist visit at the Ministry of Health today, I was prescribed Ospamox (Sandoz) 500mg, Suprazole 200mg, and Iprofen 400mg. Ospamox is prescribed in the same schedule as Neoclav: 1 tablet every 8 hours for 5 days, while the other two (Suprazole and Iprofen) are 1 tablet 3 times a day for 5 days. Should I continue taking Neoclav or switch to Ospamox as prescribed?

My 14-year-old son came home from school yesterday with pain behind his eyes, a headache, and nausea. He ate and drank normally yesterday, but today after school he barely ate, had plenty of fluids, and went straight to bed. We are African living in the UK and I’ve heard about recent cases of West Nile flu here. He does not have a fever but is very tired. Should I take him to the hospital urgently or monitor him at home?

For years I’ve had muscle spasms in my right leg, worsening after an MRI and recent lower back disc surgery (no relief except Lyrica 75mg). Now I can’t walk far, have numb toes, and severe debilitating pain in my left leg after walking over 25 ft. A sore is developing on my toe; one doctor says it’s a pressure sore and should be checked by a vascular specialist, while my ortho wants another MRI to investigate why I’m not improving. I keep mentioning significant right-sided pain and was told in 1994 I had a cyst on my right ovary. Should I pursue a gynecological evaluation to see if an ovarian issue could be contributing to my nerve pain and right leg symptoms?

I've been having severe chest pain and significant difficulty breathing. My doctor ordered two CT scans—one of my chest and one of my lower abdomen. Results showed an enlarged spleen, enlarged kidney, and swollen lymph nodes in my chest. The doctor wasn't sure about the source of my pain and prescribed pain medication plus an antibiotic. Can you help me understand what might be going on? I’m struggling to manage this pain.

Heart rate has been consistently above 120 for 6-7 hours. I have cold or flu symptoms and a fever (don’t have a thermometer). Took 360mg diltiazem 2 hours ago. Drinking lots of fluids. Sick for 3 days. Been taking Tylenol 500mg, also DayQuil and NyQuil. I have Ativan available. What should I do?

Had sex last night, then about an hour later woke up with bad lower abdomen pain. Went to pee and it hurt when urinating. It's been around 6 days since I last had sex before this. Still have some discomfort in my abdomen now, and sitting down hard makes it worse. Any idea what could be causing this?

I take 5mg Ramipril daily for high blood pressure but yesterday my BP was 172/80 or 90 even with the medication. I have an ECG scheduled next week. I already struggle with anxiety and since hearing about my BP I couldn't sleep last night. Can I take KALMS for anxiety? I also take amitriptyline for pain and penicillin because I have no spleen.

I've had stabbing pains on the right side of my head pretty frequently for the past week. I almost never get headaches—maybe 2 or 3 in my life. Two years ago I had malignant melanoma removed from my forearm. This morning I woke up with my right eye swollen enough that my husband noticed it right away. Is this something I should be worried about?

I have a rash on the head of my penis and a bit down the foreskin, but it’s never painful or itchy. My partner recently had a bladder sling put in, and the tie-off was snipped, which left a sharp edge that sometimes causes small cuts. What could this be?

22F. For the past couple months I've had chest tightness that worsens when I lie down. Blood work and x-rays at hospital were normal. I'm otherwise healthy and exercise 5x/week. What could be causing this?

Had my gallbladder and appendix taken out a while back. This past week, I’ve been getting sharp pains that feel like someone is pushing a finger out through my bellybutton from the inside—sometimes it’s so bad it takes my breath away. Happens every day, some days worse than others. When I lie down, I feel pressure there and it hurts if I touch or push on it. I’m still recovering from neck surgery and on a 10 lb lifting restriction, so I don’t think it’s from overexertion.

What are the normal blood glucose levels for a 17-year-old female who weighs 187 lbs? Asking because she’s experiencing fatigue and difficulty focusing. Please provide the standard glucose ranges—weight might be a factor but I mainly need the reference values.

My husband injured his knee over a month ago and it's still healing. Now, his arm and leg muscles are extremely sore—he can barely lift his arms. He takes ibuprofen and Flexeril daily, which gives some relief, but he’s still in a lot of pain.

My name is Prashant. My weight is 115 kg and my height is 5.65 ft. My blood pressure has spiked to 150/100 twice recently, but for the past 15 days it's been normal. I have taken BP tablets three times and my recent stress test was normal. The doctor recommended taking Nabistar 2.5 to help with office tension. Should I start this medication? If so, is it something I'll have to take for life? Please advise.

Fourth day with a kidney infection. First three days I drank a lot of extra fluids but still had urinary urgency, frequency, and low output. Today (second day on antibiotics), I haven't been drinking as much extra but now frequency and volume are up, and my urine is completely clear. I'm feeling a little thirsty. Is this likely because the antibiotic is starting to work, or could there be another reason for these changes?

I've had recurrent amoebiasis for the past 3 months. I've seen 3-4 doctors and have been prescribed ciprofloxacin, tinidazole, metrogyl, gastric juice suppressants, and entero quinal. These medicines give temporary relief, but my symptoms come back after I stop taking them. I'm also experiencing itching around my anus. What should I do?

I've had my gallbladder out, a hysterectomy, parotid tumor removal earlier this year, new thyroid issues since May, and now there’s a lump on my collarbone plus knots on my shoulder. Could all these be connected, and what might be causing them?

I’m 23 years old and currently 33 weeks pregnant. I was admitted to the hospital overnight because my heart rate went up to 205 bpm. They were able to slow it down, but it’s still over 100 bpm. I’m worried about it happening again. Can you explain why this might have happened and what I should do next?

42-year-old male, bladder & prostate cancer survivor, currently being treated for recurring bladder tumors. Gallbladder removed in February, hospitalized in March for clotting below the waist. Now experiencing ongoing right upper quadrant pain at the former gallbladder site. Gastroenterologist, family doctor, CT scan, and X-ray all done—no clear diagnosis. When massaging under my right rib, I get a sudden urge to use the restroom. This feels similar to previous delays in getting a cancer diagnosis. Still no answers and the pain continues. Looking for guidance on what steps to take next.

My blood test shows high LDL (222) and d-dimer (0.51). I have lower leg swelling, pain, and trouble breathing. A venous doppler on my legs yesterday found no clots. I’m 31, 5’2”, slightly overweight, usually healthy. What should I do next? Is there a connection between these results?
22M, sudden right testicular pain—initially sharp like being kicked, now feels vein-related. Blood test and ultrasound both came back negative. What could be causing this pain?

My 3-year-old son has been on Seroflo inhaler for about 1.5 months and uses Asthalin inhaler as needed. This time, he used Asthalin for about 5-6 days following the doctor’s advice. After that, the doctor recommended Sal Mucolite, which we gave for around 5 days. His cough is still persisting. I am very worried because he seems to always be on some medication. Please advise.

About 18 years ago, I was bitten by a tick near my hairline on the left side of my neck. I thought the tick was completely removed at the time. A few years ago, I found a large bump under the skin at that same spot, and it has slowly gotten bigger and now hurts. The bump isn’t protruding outwards but it is clearly getting larger and painful. It wasn't there before, and the pain is starting to worry me. Any ideas or advice would be appreciated.

I felt a pop in my wrist while lifting a weight bar, and had some pain at the time, but it wasn’t too bad right after. That night, the pain on the pinky side of my wrist woke me up several times. Now there’s swelling and a lot of tenderness around the bump at the base of my wrist. It hurts a lot to turn my arm or lift anything. Does this sound like a sprain, or could it be something else?

I’m 26 years old and have been smoking since I was 12. I’ve also been a passive smoker basically my whole life. I get a tingly sensation and numbness in my arms and legs pretty regularly, even when I’m just relaxing. Since I was 16, I’ve noticed white patches under my skin on my legs, which started on my calves and eventually spread. After long flights (Australia to UK, UK to Spain, UK to Brazil) I’ve experienced heart palpitations, pain in my left arm, and really painful, heavy hips and legs—sometimes the symptoms last for months. How can I improve my circulation on my own? Should I see a doctor? I’m not familiar with diets, so could you suggest what kinds of foods to eat or avoid and how often? What types of weekly exercise would help?
Had a CT scan of my spine and the report says:

21M. This morning I noticed a soft, jelly-like lump in the center of my chest—extends from just above my abs to just below my pecs, roughly golf ball sized. It isn’t uncomfortable and I only feel mild soreness if I press on it. Any idea what this could be?

Trying for pregnancy for 3 years with no success. Semen analysis: sperm count 33 million/ml, total sperm per ejaculate 99 million, motile sperm 39%, rapid linear progression 4%, slow/non linear progression 46%, non progressive 50%. Want to know if these results are ok for pregnancy. If not, what should I do? Waiting for your answer, please.

My 1-year-old daughter (12 kg) has had fever and cough for a while. Her blood test shows 19,000 WBC. Doctor prescribed Cepodem 5ml once daily, but after giving it she vomits and her coughing gets worse. Is it safe to continue the medication?

I have a 10-year-old girl with recurring stomach pains—sometimes she also has headaches and a sore throat, but the stomach pain happens most often. I’m monitoring her diet and intake. A previous doctor visit suggested she might be “backed up,” but she is able to have bowel movements. Looking for solutions. Could these symptoms be connected to early menstruation?

I’m 69 and have pain and limited range of motion in both shoulders, similar to adhesive capsulitis but without the same arm weakness I had in the past. I’ve had therapy for it before (one shoulder at a time), but now it’s both shoulders and the pain sometimes shoots down my arms and makes it hard to sleep. I’ve also been under a lot of stress moving my 94-year-old mother a long distance. Is this new pain and stiffness likely just from stress and tension, and is it safe to try treating it myself without therapy this time?

Chronic bronchitis COPD for 5 weeks, on 3 different steroids and recently started Armour Thyroid. Lungs not clearing after 3 antibiotics. Stopped dexamethasone yesterday. Feeling terrible, have adrenal insufficiency. Now experiencing burning, dark tongue and stomach is three times normal size. Also have red rash on chest and face. Am I in crisis from abrupt steroid stop? Should I take prednisone?

I’ve had lower right pelvic pain for about three weeks. I went to the ER twice; labs, scans, and ultrasounds came back normal. My primary doctor had me do upper GI and lower intestine tests—no findings. The first ob/gyn I saw said it was likely bowel or muscular, and a second ob/gyn agreed it seemed bowel-related. Now I’m referred to a GI doctor, and a colonoscopy is likely next. Despite this, I feel the issue is more gynecological since I had severe pain and spotting at the ER. I’m really frustrated and feeling down because I still don’t have answers. What could this be?

My mother is around 63 years old, has had diabetes for 20 years, and has been dealing with severe rheumatoid arthritis for the past year. She received treatment for acute renal failure (serum creatinine was 3) caused by dehydration about 4 months ago, and now her creatinine and sugar levels are back to normal. Despite taking prescribed antibiotics for three doses, her urine examination (CUE) still shows recurring pus cells in the following ranges: 8-10 hpf, 10-20 hpf, 20-30 hpf, and 30-40 hpf over time. Can you suggest any natural remedies or useful tips to help resolve this recurring problem with pus cells?

I'm 18, with a family history of high cholesterol and blood pressure issues. Sometimes I get rhythmic spasms in my left thigh and arm that match my heartbeat. It feels like my blood is pumping really strongly through those areas, and I can visibly see my pulse moving the skin. Is this something I should be worried about?

54 years old, diagnosed with costochondritis multiple times since my 20s. Used to work as a letter carrier and carried a satchel on my shoulder. Currently on disability for SI Joint Dysfunction. Over the last 3 years, I’ve had outbreaks of bumps (sometimes scaly) on my scalp and now one on my elbow, frequent mouth sores, excessive mucus in my throat, and a swollen-feeling palate or back of throat. ENT noted swollen tonsils and prescribed an antibiotic mouthwash that helped temporarily, but symptoms keep returning. Had a scope—everything looked clear. Six years ago, a yeast infection was found in my esophagus via endoscopy and was treated. I’ve had severe non-rheumatoid arthritis in my hands since my 20s, a partial rotator cuff tear, and now nerve impingement from bone spurs. I develop bone spurs in my hands as well. Asked my rheumatologist if this might be psoriatic arthritis given my history of arthritis, ligament issues, and skin eruptions—he didn’t think so. After another bump appeared on my elbow and more scalp recurrence, I requested a biopsy; results showed seborrheic keratosis. For over 2 years, I’ve had monthly episodes where it feels like I can’t get air, but my oxygen levels are consistently 98%. Pulmonary function test results available.

3 years ago I started experiencing intense itching all over my body. It’s severe and constant. My doctor diagnosed me with dermographism due to skin sensitivity and prescribed Loratadine. The medication only helps for about 4 days and then the itching returns. For the past 4 months I have also had chronic diarrhea that sometimes lasts up to 2 weeks. I also deal with mild headaches and occasional impaired vision. I am 28 years old and I have seen over 10 dermatologists with no solution found. I have done several tests including:

My doctor told me I have high blood sugar and put me on 48mg of Fenofibrate. I was told not to eat potatoes or noodles but that’s all the info I got. The medication bottle says it’s for cholesterol. I’m 45 and I don’t really understand what any of this means.

Started Cerazette two weeks ago after 15 years off the pill. My periods before this were about 5 days with 1–2 heavy days, but now I’ve had heavy bleeding with clots for over a week—bright red at times, sometimes dark brown. It’s the constant clots and dull ache (which I’m managing with paracetamol, but don’t want to rely on) that are concerning me. Should I stop taking Cerazette or keep going?

I'm experiencing tiredness, a sore chest, and occasional coughing that feels like I need to catch my breath or like there's a spasm in my throat. Sometimes I notice a fluttering sensation in my belly. This winter, walking in cold weather made my chest very sore, and though it's better now that it's warmer, I still feel some discomfort. Recently, I've also been having post nasal drip.
I've had two episodes of esophageal bleeding and have been banded twice, as well as having two TIPS procedures for my liver. How often should I get re-banded to prevent bleeding from happening again?

My 81-year-old mother (very active until recently) is experiencing worsening shortness of breath over the last 90 days. She had a heart attack 11 years ago with a five-way bypass and already has an ICD implanted (defibrillator and pacemaker). Heart rate, blood pressure, and oxygen levels are currently good. Medications like Multaq and amiodarone were tried but side effects were too much. She’s still taking Coreg. Is AV node ablation a reasonable treatment option given this situation?

I got married 8 months ago and my wife hasn’t conceived yet. The doctor checked my wife and prescribed Consevel capsules for her to take every morning and night. She’s been taking them daily for a month, but she’s still not pregnant and has started gaining weight. Can you explain why she hasn’t conceived yet?

15-year-old girl, 155 cm, 58 kg. I’ve had fever for 2 months, plus left-sided abdominal pain for the last 2 days (started severe, now mild). The pain gets worse if I yawn or cough. No previous health problems. Took paracetamol for the fever, but it’s not getting better. The fever started after coming from UAE to India. What could be the cause of these symptoms?

Describe what it might mean if I notice light orange discharge on the toilet paper after wiping, followed by orange discharge in my underwear and light blood when wiping the next day. What could be going on?

Woke up today with heart pounding, pulse was 110. Couldn't take a deep breath, hard/bloated feeling above navel. Felt like throwing up, dry heaved multiple times (at least 5). Weakness after, but heart rate and breathing improved. Tightness and bloating above navel a bit better, but still present. I have a hernia in that area (repaired, failed shortly after, years ago), and history of esophagitis (but this didn’t feel like that). Multiple health conditions, on several meds. Had a similar episode last month—more dizziness that time, hands tingled for about an hour. This time I slept 10+ hours after, still exhausted. Hands a bit tingly, upper body shaky. I have multiple autoimmune and neurological diseases. Just sharing in case you have insight.

I’ve been experiencing tongue swelling at night for a while, and last night I had a burning sensation that kept me awake. My upper palate is also affected. I have a history of chronic heartburn, and I’m a 15-year breast cancer survivor. Are these issues related?

I'm 29 and recently lost my father. Since then, I've been suffering from extreme stress and anxiety, unable to sleep until 3 or 4 am, with my mind racing and full of unwanted thoughts I can’t stop. Over the past year, I’ve gained a lot of weight and now have blood pressure issues. Lately, I've felt an urge to drink my face toner and sometimes find myself staring at it. Another night, when my face was itching, I wanted to scratch it and even considered marking or coloring on it with a ball pen. I’m confused and struggling with these feelings—please advise.

I missed my regular birth control pill on Saturday and had unprotected sex on Sunday. I realized the missed pill later, so I took both the missed birth control pills and Plan B on Tuesday. My period is supposed to come next week, but I thought Plan B might make it arrive early. I don’t have any pregnancy symptoms, but I’m worried—should I be concerned about the risk of being pregnant?

My boyfriend has an overly sensitive penis and thinks a doctor can't help, but I disagree. What treatments, medications, or procedures might a doctor suggest for this issue? Are there any surgeries for penile sensitivity?

I’m 6 weeks pregnant and had my hCG levels drawn twice 48 hours apart when I was 3 weeks pregnant, and the numbers almost tripled in that time. Lately, I’ve been feeling some discomfort (not pain) on my left side, mostly when I have to pee or have a bowel movement. My OB/GYN appointment isn’t until next week. Could this side discomfort be related to the corpus luteum?

I recently had an MRI and neuropsych testing after seeing a neurologist for worsening symptoms. My father had Alzheimer's starting in his mid-60s and died at 74. The MRI showed brain shrinkage above average for my age, but the doctors weren’t concerned and said my testing was average, with no Alzheimer’s diagnosis. Still, my symptoms keep getting worse and my latest IQ score was 114, which is 18 points below my previous result from five years ago. I’m almost 65 and concerned about my decline. Is there anything else I can do?

For about a year now, I’ve been experiencing a strong smell of gasoline that comes and goes—sometimes lasting weeks—making me nauseous. I’ve just been diagnosed with a sinus infection and bronchitis, but the smell has happened before even when I wasn’t sick. This all started around the time my husband passed away, which was a highly stressful period. I’m frustrated and tired of this recurring issue. Should I consider seeing an ENT specialist, or do you have other suggestions?

My 3.5-month-old baby was previously on a combination of breast milk and formula (Nan Pro 1). Since around 2.5 months old, he started rejecting formula—he only takes about 1 oz and then vomits it all out immediately. Why would he suddenly start rejecting formula, and what can I do to help him accept formula again?

I've had a lump below my armpit and above my breast for about 5 years—my name is Dwayne. It's recently gotten bigger, red, irritated, and sometimes itchy. Could this be cancer, or what else might it be?

65-year-old male with psoriasis on center fingers—mainly the fingertips—which get dry, crack, and sometimes bleed unless medication is used. Current treatment includes topical Molsturex, Xerina, Halox, Beclate, and oral Predmet 8. I’ve noticed that Predmet 8 tablets are most effective for relief, but symptoms return about a month after stopping the tablets.

On 09/12 I saw a doctor for an infected ingrown hair that needed to be drained, and was told it was caused by a strep infection. My lab results showed Eosinophils at 0.43. I had a repeat test on 09/17 and the level increased slightly to 0.45. My wound was checked again on 09/17 and there were no signs of ongoing infection—it’s healing. No antibiotics were prescribed because the doctor thinks my fevers are from stress. Can you give me some advice?
